entry_conditions: Enter when observations show red_pose and blue_pose vertically aligned in world xy, blue_pose z near table height about 0.020 m, red_pose z about one cube above blue, the blue cube not intentionally displaced, and the gripper/TCP still needing to approach or grasp the top red cube. The model uses causal fields red_pose, blue_pose, tcp_pose, qpos finger positions, qvel, and the fixed red_goal/blue_goal.
exit_conditions: Exit when the causal observation shows red lifted well clear of blue while blue_pose remains near its source xy and table-level z, with the gripper closed around/near red and TCP/red beginning lateral transport toward the red goal. Demonstrated end states around index 190 have red z about 0.30 m, blue z about 0.020 m, closed finger positions near 0.018 m, and red xy moving toward negative y.
overlap_role: The overlap [130, 190) is learned as part of this policy, not skipped. In this phase red-blue clearance is already large enough for safe transition, and the policy learns to preserve the stationary blue cube while changing from vertical lift to lateral red carry. The successor may also learn this interval, so transfer can occur after stable red clearance is visible rather than at a single geometric instant.
successor_readiness: A successor red-placement policy should receive a state with blue still at the original source/table pose, red held high above it, TCP close to red, and gripper closed. Causal cues include red_pose.z - blue_pose.z greater than the initial stack separation by a large margin, red/TCP xy no longer centered over blue, and finger aperture near the closed demonstrated value.
failure_signatures: Poor handoff signs are blue_pose xy moving by more than a few millimetres, blue z/orientation departing from the table-level support pose, red and blue z separation remaining close to the initial 0.04 m stack separation after attempted grasp, gripper not closing near red, or substantial lateral TCP/red motion while red is still not clear of blue. These are observational warnings, not hard constraints implemented by the model.
continuation_guidance: Continue this policy through approach, descent, grasp closure, and vertical lift. During the transition continue it if red is still gaining clearance or if red is high but TCP/red lateral motion is only beginning. Hand off when blue stability and red clearance are both visible and the next policy can take over carrying red toward the red goal. If blue has already been displaced or red is not held, this learned prior has no tested recovery behavior.
limitations: The handoff guidance is based on state observations from successful demonstrations and measured overlap evidence. It infers grasp from gripper aperture and red/TCP co-motion, not force/contact sensing. The policy does not perform IK, enforce hard collision constraints, or guarantee recovery outside the demonstrated stacked-block distribution.
